state: Proposed portable contract; unpublished; runtime expectations not executed
authority: User decisions amend the supplied guide; original files remain preserved source material.

initialization.readBeforePublication: Uninitialized-state error; initialization flag remains false.
initialization.validationFailure: Collect independent safe issues, publish nothing; a later valid attempt remains possible.
initialization.success: Publish one complete immutable snapshot and return the same instance observed by current-state reads.
initialization.repeat: Already-initialized-state error; never replace the published snapshot.
initialization.concurrent: Exactly one successful publisher; no partial reads.
initialization.sideEffects: Resolution/publication does not create outputs, start workers, mutate process variables or contact infrastructure.

buildIdentity.entryAssembly: Fallback only when an explicit application assembly is not supplied.
buildIdentity.coreAssembly: Never substitute Core identity for application identity.
buildIdentity.serviceVersion: Configurable telemetry release label; distinct from actual BuildVersion.
buildIdentity.commitAndBuildIds: Explicit build inputs only; never inferred from version suffixes/filenames.

processFacts.processStartedAt: Actual nullable process start in UTC; never initialization time.
processFacts.instanceId: New UUID string per successful application initialization, stable for that run.
processFacts.host: Observed application-visible host, optional when unavailable; never DD_AGENT_HOST.
processFacts.architectures: Optional lowercase normalized runtime architecture names.

ownership.setup: Caller-owned mutable startup input; resolver copies all selected fields and nested logging input before publication.
ownership.resolved: Sealed, getter-only outputs; no retained caller-owned mutable state.
ownership.metadata: Allowlisted copied process facts; excludes configuration, destinations and operation context.

diagnostics.collection: Owned immutable copy, including immutable issue values.
diagnostics.safeExplanation: No raw input values, arbitrary environment variables, paths, credentials or collector addresses.

metadataProjection: Allowlisted identity/process facts only; excludes logging settings, paths, destinations, credentials, arbitrary environment variables and operation context.
futureImplementations: Declare supported runtime capabilities and apply portable expectations; C# namespace/assembly/signature mechanics remain specific to C#.
